title: As above, so below
sub: A loop that starts and ends on a single bead of Lyra's DNA. It pulls out through her cell, her eye and the flowers she's lying in, past the Milky Way to the edge of the universe, and keeps going until our universe is a marble in the palm of one of its keepers, strung with others like DNA on its spools. Then it falls back into the bead it started on.

title: The journey
sub: Lyra lies in the flowers by the temple in Seven Havens. The camera pulls out past the Earth, the Sun and the Milky Way to the edge of the observable universe, then dives all the way back into her eye and down to the DNA in one of her cells. It's thirty-five powers of ten in one shot.

title: Trailer
sub: The journey in twenty-five seconds. Out from the flowers to the cosmic web, then back into Lyra's eye and down to the DNA in one of her cells.
